title: Dario Amodei says Anthropic has a higher retention than OpenAI, emphasizing its "mission" as a way to reinforce staff loyalty and fend off competitors' offers (The Information)
summary: The Information: Dario Amodei says Anthropic has a higher retention than OpenAI, emphasizing its “mission” as a way to reinforce staff loyalty and fend off competitors' offers — Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Tuesday touted the company's ability to fend off its competitors from recruiting its staff …
